messages:
hana (Docs): Opening a tiny PR to clarify SOC2/audit-log wording and add an SDK header + retention API example. Need quick legal+security eyes.

rob (Security): Quick: use 'recommended' not a hard promise, call out append-only storage + integrity checks, and mention PII redaction.

nina (Legal): Agreed. Add that retention may be extended for legal/regulatory reasons and customer contracts can override defaults. Avoid firm guarantees in public docs.

hana (Docs): Draft copy: 'Audit logs: Redwood retains audit logs to support security investigations, compliance, and contractual obligations. Recommended retention: 90 days (dev), 24 months (prod). Actual retention is configurable and subject to customer agreements and legal obligations. Sensitive fields can be redacted before long-term storage; see the redaction guide.'

kevin (DevEx): Nit: use 'Redwood retains' for consistency. Also include a Node SDK snippet showing the audit header and a sample retention API payload for Dedicated/Private customers.

hana (Docs): Node snippet I'll add: // attach audit metadata for traceability
await client.generate({ model: 'rw-instruct-1', input: 'Summarize this', headers: { 'x-redwood-audit-id': 'acct-42-evt-1001' } });

kevin (DevEx): Retention API sample: { "policy_name": "prod-default", "retention_days": 730, "redaction": { "pii_fields": ["email"], "method": "mask" } }

rob (Security): Add sentence: 'Audit logs are stored append-only with integrity monitoring; deletions are logged and require approval.' Good for audits.

nina (Legal): +1. If we surface numbers, label them 'recommended' and coordinate with sales for any contractual SLAs.

hana (Docs): Link check: redaction anchor currently at /docs/data-redaction#audit-logs? Alex from infra usually confirms.

infra-bot: docs build queued: CI: ✅, staging: ✅

hana (Docs): Thanks — I'll update the PR and merge after legal sign-off.
